title: ptbr-writer: português técnico controlado para pessoas e agentes
description: ptbr-writer rewrites technical text in Brazilian Portuguese for a single reading: explicit subject, one proposition per sentence and consistent terms. It adapts the 8 rules of Português Técnico Controlado (PTC), by kayquer, and adds 5, for 13 rules in total, PTW-1 to PTW-13. Each request goes through one of 5 levels of rigor, from estrito to smart-note. For text with sources, the cientifico skill adds 12 rules, CIE-1 to CIE-12. The same rules reach the writer by three paths: a Claude Code plugin, an installer for OpenCode and a browser extension for Chrome and Firefox. The extension treats a review as a decision: besides models that generate text (Claude, DeepSeek or a local model through Ollama), it accepts a local decision model, served by Ollaya, which says which rule each sentence breaks, with a probability, and generates no text. The runtime tools are static Rust binaries pinned by sha256, and each claim that was not checked carries a warning mark. No measure of accuracy is reported: the regression cases are written and were not run, and the latency and accuracy of the local models on pt-BR were not measured.
